- scripts/claude_engine.py:821-822 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The hours are rounded before the sign check, so a reset 1-179 seconds in the future reads "now" while the window is still unavailable.
  WHY: Operators see "resets now" for up to about three minutes. The reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 gave confidence 2 and recommended dropping it, because the `_format_reset_in` docstring and `tests/test_claude_engine.py` document and pin this behavior. openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash gave confidence 5, and they note it conflicts with the looser `pool_health` docstring.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/claude_engine.py:821-822 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: A reset 1 to 179 seconds away reads `now`, because the hours are rounded to one decimal before the sign check.
  WHY: The effect is cosmetic and the message is sent at most once an hour. The behavior is deliberate and documented in the `_format_reset_in` docstring. `tests/test_claude_engine.py::test_format_reset_in_reads_now_for_a_reset_under_three_minutes_away` pins it. The reviewer would drop this finding.

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/claude_engine.py:821-822 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The duration is rounded before the positivity check, so a reset 1-179 seconds in the future is reported as "now". The test at tests/test_claude_engine.py:695-696 expects this for a reset 60 seconds away, but the PR says "now" applies once the reset time has passed.
  WHY: Operators are told the account is resetting now even though it stays unavailable for up to nearly three minutes.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/claude_engine.py:821-822 (with tests/test_claude_engine.py:695-697) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A reset up to 179 seconds in the future is reported as "now" because the duration is rounded before the positivity check (`shown = round((seconds - now) / 3600, 1)`, then `f"in {shown:.1f}h" if shown > 0 else "now"`). The test at tests/test_claude_engine.py:695-697 expects a reset 60 seconds away to read "now".
  WHY: Operators are told a window is resetting now while it stays unavailable for up to nearly three minutes. This conflicts with the `pool_health` documentation at scripts/claude_engine.py:866-867. The function-level docstring at scripts/claude_engine.py:815-817 documents the under-0.05h behavior and the test pins it, so this is a deliberate documented choice.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
